# Invariant token factories with all-star array contexts

Class<T> and Constructor<T> retain one method-owned Object formal while a
Class<?>[] tail contributes no binding. Original varargs declarations receive
the original array at fixed arity. A competing broad overload qualifies member
selection. Four frozen invocation paths run 192 fresh cases twice, checking
array identity and mutation, null and primitive tokens, callback failures,
opaque constructor identity, and deferred construction and value casts.
Fifteen wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the
observers. Source and SDK paths compile every emitted source and check original
definitions, roles, Signature and Exceptions attributes.
